decisions.reason: Operator training builds on the firm's core service offer, had its own website page in two consecutive years, and is cheap to sustain while supporting machine sales, so management has every reason to persist with it.

The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the established machine platform and fits the announced direction of configurable systems, so even modest sales can be justified as part of the system offering.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and was only mentioned on the website, but it embodies the publicly announced push into future-oriented production and digital workflows, so management will likely blame weak results on an immature market and keep investing for now.
The high-speed CNC milling line is a multi-model product close to the core, with heavy R&D investment and a prominent dedicated page, which makes dropping it highly unlikely.
The automatic tool change system is a showcased, invested complement to the milling machines and central to the firm's efficiency promise, so the firm will keep it.
